summary: Maps a track scene name (read from a track descriptor at dword_8AC490 + 396*a2, offset +260) to a display/commentary ID. The result depends on layout flag a3 (alternate vs primary) and event flag a4 (dry vs wet). On success stores the resolved ID, a computed value from ShortComputation_41a0, and clears a status byte into the output struct at a1; returns 0 on success, 1 on early failure.

ShortComputation_41a0(1u) computes a secondary value into v5 that gates the success path.
When v5 is negative, return failure (1) immediately.

Compute the track descriptor pointer: dword_8AC490 + 396*a2, then read the track name at descriptor offset +260.
Guard on the computed track descriptor being non-null before dereferencing it.

When layout flag a3 is set, compare the track name against all seventeen track scene names (Albert Park through Indianapolis) via sub_566810 and assign the alternate-layout display ID for the matching track.
When layout flag a3 is clear, compare the track name against the same seventeen track scene names and assign the primary-layout display ID for the matching track.
On a resolved positive result, StringCopyWithBufferRealloc copies the track name into the byte_5EA438 buffer.
Store the output: a1 + 8 = resolved display ID, a1 + 12 = v5, and clear the status byte at a1 + 16.
Return 0 when a valid ID was stored (v5 > 0 and v4 > 0), otherwise return 1 for failure.
